transcript.text: Our brand new AEG FSE52407Z dishwasher keeps opening its own door a few inches near the end of the programme. Is the catch faulty? It's only 2 weeks old.

Please do not force the door open or shut, and never attempt to force or bypass the door lock. Open the dishwasher door and check that nothing in the racks or the cutlery basket is sticking out. Once clear, shut the door firmly until you hear it click, then press start. Does it still show the door as open?

Thanks. It shuts and latches normally at the start and the display doesn't say the door is open. It's only near the end of the cycle that it clicks and eases open a few inches, with a puff of steam, while the remaining time is still showing.

Thanks for letting us know the door is recognised but still won’t start. Please switch the machine off at the socket and unplug it first. Look only — no tools on the catch or the lock. With the dishwasher switched off at the socket, look at the latch at the top of the door and the slot it clicks into on the tub, and check the door lines up squarely when you close it. Is the latch or catch broken, was something stopping it (now cleared), or does it all look fine?

I've unplugged it and had a look, but I'm not sure what I'm looking for, so I can't tell if anything's wrong with the latch. It doesn't start with a problem though, it only opens near the end of the cycle. Sorry, to be clear, it's not failing to start.

Many dishwashers feature a child or control lock, often marked by a key or padlock symbol, which disables the buttons. Your manual will show you which buttons to hold down to turn this feature off. Was the child / control lock on (and is it off now), or was it already off?
I don't think a child lock has anything to do with it, the buttons work fine and I haven't turned one on. Is the door opening itself at the end meant to happen on this model?

Thanks for confirming the child lock status. A delay start, often shown as a countdown like "3h", or a programme that hasn't been confirmed can look like it won't start. Was a delay start set or the programme not selected (and is it sorted), or was nothing like that set?
